name: Corinthia Grand Hotel du Boulevard Bucharest
positioning: Historic hotel in Bucharest, reopened by Corinthia in March 2025 after years of restoration, close to the city's opera and concert halls
best_for: Culture lovers who want easy access to the Opera House and the George Enescu Philharmonia
Travelers drawn to historic hotels with a restored ballroom

facts.text: The hotel reopened to guests on 24 March 2025 after several years of renovation and restoration.
The hotel has deep historical significance in Bucharest.
The hotel is at 21 Regina Elisabeta Avenue in Bucharest's District 5.
Bucharest is home to cultural institutions such as the National Museum of Art and the Romanian Peasant Museum.
The hotel has two restaurants and a bar, the Heritage Bar.
Sass Restaurant & Lounge is inspired by the Sass Cafe in Monaco.
The spa has two private treatment rooms.
The spa includes a Finnish sauna, a steam room, an experience shower and an ice fountain.

highlights.text: After several years of renovation and restoration, the hotel welcomed guests again on 24 March 2025.
The Boulevard 73 restaurant is set in the historic ballroom and specialises in French-Romanian farm-to-table cuisine.
The hotel offers convenient access to theatres and music venues, including the Opera House and the George Enescu Philharmonia.
The spa has a Finnish sauna, a steam room, an experience shower and an ice fountain.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
WhataHotel notes the historic building may have some structural limitations.
